h: Omah Lay reportedly breaks silence on an accident and postpones some Clarity of Mind tour dates
p: Singer Omah Lay has reportedly addressed an accident and said some dates of his Clarity of Mind tour will be pushed back. Details of his condition and the new dates were not immediately clear.
more: The tour supports his latest album and was due to run through November.
Fans have been sending him messages of support online.
